visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, steaming circular vat filled with thick, brown soup is shown. A hand uses a metal ladle to stir the duck meat and bamboo shoots, pouring them into white ceramic bowls. Bright yellow text is centered on the screen. (2) A young woman with dark hair and a white winter jacket appears in a close-up, holding a red and white paper cup. She smiles excitedly and takes a bite with a metal spoon, her eyes widening. (3) Shots of the food preparation area: a hand pours thick broth from a metal tube into a large vat. More close-ups show the duck meat soup being stirred and topped with red chili flakes. The woman is seen in various street backgrounds, laughing and talking to the camera. (4) A young man with glasses and a red jacket demonstrates a 'hidden' eating method by vigorously shaking a packet of red chili powder into the soup cup. The soup becomes heavily covered in red powder. (5) Several different people, including an older woman and the man from before, are shown eating the soup and giving positive reactions. The scene cuts to other local dishes like braised pork rice and fish before returning to the woman finishing her soup in a final close-up.
